item: The Field data button saves the OSM daily change files' measured cost
summary: 0.6 gate row B owes the measured daily diff cost for one country. The cost was stored per applied change file (osm_diff_runs: bytes fetched, fetch and apply seconds) but left the machine only inside the full Diagnostics zip, whose volumes reach 4 MB, past the 200 KB a person can send back. GET /api/osm/change-files now runs the zip's own osm-change-files.json slot (its 20 KB budget, its cuts and the slot scrub), and the Field data button saves it as oo-field-{press}-osm-change-files.json. Local and read-only: counts, times and sizes, never an object, tag, path or URL.
